title: A short "Yes" in an English chat stays English

messages.text: Hi, I need a website for my bakery with online ordering please.
Happy to help — a business website with ordering starts at 60,000 PKR. Shall I put the scope together?
Yes please, and I want the online ordering part included in the scope.
Noted: business website with online ordering. What is the deadline you have in mind?

turns.expect: a two-word acknowledgement must not change the conversation's language

model.text: Great — what deadline are you working towards? That is the last thing I need for the scope.
